Use the timecode sync feature to coordinate with other devices if needed. Start recording by pressing the record button and monitor levels to ensure optimal audio capture. After recording, safely transfer your files to a computer for editing.

Care instructions

Keep the Zoom F8N clean by wiping it with a soft, dry cloth after use. Avoid exposure to moisture, extreme temperatures, and dust to maintain performance. Store the recorder in a protective case when not in use to prevent damage. Regularly check and replace batteries or use reliable power sources to avoid interruptions during recording sessions.
